notes: All 14 source and 18 target ids are partitioned exactly once; heads are members of their arrays throughout.

s013 is MACULA's object marker אֵת rendered by *with* in *speak with thee*. Rule 16's first family (an English verb reaching its object through a preposition) licenses this, and the same tokens result if the form is read as the homograph preposition H854 under rule 11, so the unit is stable either way.
The two verb units (s002, s012) correctly hold their English subject pronouns and auxiliary under rule 17 and head on the lexical verbs *said* and *speak* (rule 24).
